model: RandomForestClassifier (n_estimators=300, random_state=0) with median imputation of zero-coded missing values (glucose, blood_pressure, skin_thickness, insulin, bmi)
notes: Excluded followup_score because it nearly perfectly separates outcome (likely recorded after diagnosis, i.e. leakage); with it CV accuracy was ~0.96 versus ~0.76 without. Split 80/20 stratified, random_state=42.
